name: As-Salih Ayyub
role: Ayyubid sultan of Egypt from 1240 to 1249
contribution: The Ayyubid ruler of Egypt from 1240 to 1249.

checks.lead: Al-Malik as-Salih Najm al-Din Ayyub (Arabic: الصالح نجم الدين أيوب; 5 November 1205 – 22 November 1249), Kunya: Abu al-Futuh (Arabic: أبو الفتوح), also known as al-Malik al-Salih, was the Ayyubid ruler of Egypt from 1240 to 1249.
